ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), $RecordType.DeveloperName='Invoice', Bypass_Validation__c=false, OR( AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity_Name__r.Defer_Billing_or_Exit_Case__c, 'To Be Billed'))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Opportunity_Name__r.StageName , 'Closed Won'))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An invoice can only be generated when the opportunity is 'Closed Won' and the Billing Status of the opportunity is 'To Be Billed'
